recipe: No training. D1 and D3 are blended exactly: ΔW = (1−λ)·ΔW(D1) + λ·ΔW(D3), one rank-16 adapter per λ (scripts/merge_adapters.py). λ = 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7.
why: D3 learned the new corrections (39/54) and lost familiar cases (783/801); D1 keeps them (787) and fails the new ones (24). A blend of the two is the cheapest test of whether both can be had.
gate: A blend replaces D1 only if the 54 generated held-out drafts improve with no D1 success lost, the 42 v22 cases are not worse than D1, and familiar retention is not below D1 (787/801).
limits: λ is chosen on the same held-out sets the gate uses; with three values that is a small selection effect.
